text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Crossing the line in first!! The winner 
is――"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan, you were amazing!" "She's 
incredible in the Senior Class too." "No 
spectators is so lonely ;;" "I hope I can 
see Love-chan in person soon."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Ai is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —...Still a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I am far from absolute 
perfection. Almond Eye's running should be 
capable of so much more...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san. You're already looking 
toward what's next, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Running together today made me realize 
it all over again.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(What's truly amazing about Ai-san is the 
strength of her heart.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Even at the peak of the era, believing in 
oneself: 'I can become even stronger'... 
'There are no limits'...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(That straightforward, unshakeable belief 
must be... what Ai-san has, and what I 
lack—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I have to become stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer-kun. I want to believe more 
strongly too, just like Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-chan. I want to believe more 
strongly too, just like Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And I want to show them. The preciousness 
of the love we cherish so deeply... The 
absolute strength of my own love...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I... I don't think I could 
encourage our community members through 
tough times like these.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that world stage we were all 
aiming for together will drift further 
away—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Please, Trainer-kun. Tell me which race 
I should aim for next...!

—In that case, there's only one goal to 
aim for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With today's race, Loves Only You must 
have made it abundantly clear that she 
stands at the very forefront of this era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we are to take the next step, you 
should run in races where the center of 
the era gathers, solidifying your 
reputation even further.
choice_data_list:
Let's run the Grand Prix—the Takarazuka 
Kinen

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand festival where the dreams of 
racing fans converge. Achieving results 
there will undoubtedly leave an even 
stronger impression of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The stage where everyone's dreams 
gather... Indeed, there could be no better 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. To the Takarazuka Kinen. There, 
I will prove that I've become even 
stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light residing in Loves Only You's 
eyes shines powerfully toward the future. 
And seeing that brilliance brought me a 
sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she was able to make a complete 
recovery from the heartbreak in Dubai—

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment 1
text_block_list.text:
"‘Watching Almond Eye's races always gets 
me so pumped. I can't help wondering what 
kind of incredible run she'll show us 
next.’"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment 2
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Almond Eye's races lately might 
just be what keeps me going. Her running 
gives me the most energy right now."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...They really are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...With her running, Ai-san truly 
encourages so many people.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...To so many people that my running 
could never reach—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If only I were as strong as Ai-san, I 
could encourage my community members even 
more—"
—Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
C-Chrono-chan?! Did you hear that just 
now...?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...? N-No. I haven't heard anything, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Um. May I... talk to you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course♪ Well then, shall we head 
back to our room?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. But, um... I'd like 
to change the venue a bit—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the sunset is so pretty today♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. ......You are, right.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what brought you all the way out 
to a place like this?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Today, um... ...I'd like to make a 
declaration.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard... that Loves-chan... plans to 
run in the 'Takarazuka Kinen'..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What I'm about to say now is... not for 
Love-chan, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It is aimed at Loves Only You... who runs 
at the very forefront of the Tiara 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —I will not yield.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The one who will carve their 
hoofprints into history at the 'Takarazuka 
Kinen'... is me, Chrono Genesis."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because we are in an unprecedented era... 
one shaking the racing world... That is 
precisely why I wish to stand, radiant, at 
its very center.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So... this is a declaration. That I will 
unconditionally win the Takarazuka Kinen. 
My—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (............What eyes full of love.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...I can feel it. Chrono-chan's love for 
racing history.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure Chrono-chan is... trying to 
return that love by putting herself at the 
very center of history.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(To the racing world, which has fallen 
into an unprecedented state——)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(And Chrono-chan firmly believes that she 
can do it...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I want to triumph over that love of 
Chrono-chan's. I have to win. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Let's settle this. ————Chrono Genesis."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Let us both continue to hone our 
skills.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And... in the coming Takarazuka Kinen, let 
us pour... everything into it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again this year, time marches on 
toward the stage where dreams gather—
